Limerick Generator

Generate silly five-line limericks with a true AABBA rhyme scheme from rhyming word banks.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Generate limerick.
  2. Read your five-line poem.
  3. Generate again or copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is AABBA enforced?

Lines 1, 2 and 5 share one rhyme; lines 3 and 4 share another, shorter rhyme — enforced by the word banks.

Where do the rhymes come from?

Rhyming pairs like Nantucket/bucket and places, people and mishaps are picked fresh each time.

Will I get a different limerick each time?

Yes — the person, place, action and rhyme pairs are picked randomly on every generate.
